_comment: SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation (Kaggle, stage 1 files). Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Sources: the Kaggle data page (stage 1: 10,675 train images in train-rle.csv, 1,377 test images), and the raw files read with pandas and pydicom (train-rle.csv, the DICOM headers). train-rle.csv has one line per pneumothorax region (11,582 lines). 2,379 images have 3,286 regions, and 8,296 images have -1 (no pneumothorax). No image has both. 37 train DICOM files have no line in train-rle.csv, so they are not in the table. Every image has a mask_path: an RLE string or -1 (D-33). The DICOM PatientID is unique for each image, so patients = images. Sex and age are only in the DICOM headers. 2 train ages are over 100, probably data errors. The age rule of radharmony/harmonizer/_age.py gives NaN for an age above 130, so age_years has no such value (D-06). The test images have no labels (D-25).
